pages.title: A Cultured Hobby
pages.text: Fermentation belongs in the kitchen too.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Put milk in a cauldron, add a brown mushroom, let it mature and collect the cheese with a bucket. The objective checks the finished bucket.

pages.title: Useful to know
pages.text: Milk in a cauldron with a Brown Mushroom starts native cheese preparation. Wait and collect with a bucket. Cheese supports pizza recipes; placed pizzas are served in portions.
